Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Actuarial Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Actuarial Services provides comprehensive actuarial analysis, risk assessment, and appraisal services primarily focused on the automotive sector. Our team of expert actuaries and appraisers leverages extensive industry knowledge to deliver accurate valuations and insights for clients, including automotive repair shops, insurers, and financial institutions. We emphasize data-driven methodologies and compliance with regulatory standards, ensuring that our clients receive reliable assessments that support their business decisions.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a fire incident occurred due to unaddressed fire code violations, resulting in damage to office equipment and data loss. The estimated loss amounted to $50,000, with the claim currently in review by the insurance adjuster. Additionally, on April 22, 2023, a minor water leak caused $25,000 in damages, which has been resolved and the claim paid.

Underwriting Guidelines:
This expanded guidance aims to assist underwriters in accurately assessing risks and expo-
sures associated with auto parts and accessories businesses, ensuring appropriate coverage while
mitigating potential liabilities.
3.22
Auto Services & Repair
Underwriting Appetite
• Preferred:
– Standard automotive repair shops primarily engaged in mechanical repairs, diagnostics,
and routine maintenance (e.g., oil changes, brake repairs) without 24-hour operations or
salvage activities. These shops typically do not perform high-risk services such as racing
modifications or demolition work.
– Facilities with secure, well-maintained premises that demonstrate compliance with OSHA
regulations, including proper employee training and safety protocols. Fire protection
measures should be documented and include automatic sprinkler systems or approved
fire extinguishers, particularly in paint and flammable storage areas.
